title: 2026-11-14 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：SubGPU Pipelining (NVIDIA) 卡内空间流水线，每用户吞吐 2.2×、GC-MoE on SM120 (Alibaba Inc.) 消费级 Blackwell 融合 MoE，快 1.52×、Recompute or Restore (Korea University) NPU 主机 KV 层，SLO 22.8%→100%、Batch Makespan Coordination (Ling Team) agent 批量调度，makespan 降 65%、Read Once, Answer Many (UC Santa Cruz) 共享文档多流解码，A100 3.7×、TraceKV (Duke University) 推理 VLM 低秩 KV，5.64× 压缩、SignRot (Hanyang University) 符号对齐旋转量化，超 SpinQuant、Starscream (AMD Research and Advanced Development) chiplet 卡内切分，注意力 4×、Optical Broadcast Memory (Uppsala University) 权重光学广播，省 PB 级 HBM、SlipStream (Georgia Tech) HBF 需求定速预取，达理想 92.4%

highlights.name: SubGPU Pipelining
highlights.note: 卡内按 SM 池切段做空间流水，匹配吞吐下每用户吞吐最高 2.2×

highlights.name: GC-MoE on SM120
highlights.note: 消费级 Blackwell 上重建融合 MoE 算子，PCIe 8 卡比 MegaMoE 快 1.52×

highlights.name: Read Once, Answer Many
highlights.note: 同文档多问题合成 P 条流一次解码，A100 上快 3.7×
